billing.pci_boundary: Card details NEVER cross this contract. Checkout is a redirect to the payment provider; the control plane sees only provider webhooks.

provider_routing.byok: provider_kind is an open enum (new providers additively, MINOR bump); consumers MUST NOT hardcode provider lists. Field names are vendor-neutral everywhere.

cost.reservation_required_note: Billable operations require a quota reservation first; consumers receive cost_cap_exceeded, never a surprise bill.

privacy.chess_content_note: No games, moves, FENs, analysis or notes in any field of any operation, in either direction.
privacy.key_material_note: Provider keys and credentials are accepted only in fields flagged write_only and MUST NOT appear in any response, log line or error message.

recovery.recovery_note: entitlements.get responses carry the TTL field; consumers may serve cached entitlements that long when unreachable, then degrade to free tier. Reservations carry the expiry field; consumers MUST treat expired ones as released.

auth.rule: A valid bearer token is REQUIRED for every operation not listed in public_operations; operations that REQUIRE it answer 401 when the token is missing, unknown or expired: unknown tokens answer auth_invalid, expired tokens answer auth_expired. No cookies, no query tokens, no exceptions.

errors.additive_note: Error payloads MAY carry extra fields beyond the declared shape (MINOR additive); error signalling keys on the HTTP status only, so a 2xx payload containing an 'error' field is data, not an error.

transport.idempotency: Every mutating operation REQUIRES an Idempotency-Key header (unique nonempty string per logical operation). A replay with the same key AND the same canonical request body returns the original outcome with no duplicate effect. The same key with a DIFFERENT body answers 409 idempotency_conflict. Keys are scoped per authenticated account.
transport.read_only_rule: Operations with mutating: false MUST be listed in read_only_operations, and every listed operation MUST be mutating: false. A state-changing operation flipped to mutating: false without allowlisting is an idempotency bypass and fails the contract lint.
transport.self_destructive_rule: Operations whose success invalidates the calling credential MUST be listed in self_destructive_operations, MUST be mutating and MUST require auth. For these operations the idempotency replay lookup runs BEFORE credential validity checks, scoped by the presented credential itself, never its validity: a retry with the same Idempotency-Key and a byte-identical body replays the recorded outcome; the same key with a different body answers idempotency_conflict; without a recorded first call a revoked credential answers 401 as usual. Replay returns only what the caller already received and can never authorize new work.

versioning.rule: Clients pin MAJOR. MINOR is additive-only: new optional request fields, new response fields, new operations or new provider_kind values. A server MUST accept any client minor within its major and MUST ignore unknown request fields. Rollback: a consumer may downgrade to any earlier MINOR within the same MAJOR without migration, because conformance never asserts absence of extra response fields. MAJOR bumps require a new base path.
